title: Information Technology Equipment -- Safety, Part 1: General Requirements
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements, tolerances, test methods, and compliance specifications for Information Technology Equipment -- Safety, Part 1: General Requirements as prescribed under IS 13252 (PART 1) by the Bureau of Indian Standards.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Information Technology Equipment -- Safety - General Requirements

marking_requirements: Each product/package must bear the manufacturer's name, trademark, and grade.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS ISI Mark) subject to licensing.
